messages:
sam: prod edge-proxy 502 spike traced to header-parsing crash in the latest runtime image. Need an expedited hotfix and approval to cut within the hour. Suggesting image redwood/edge-proxy:hotfix-030.
lee: Can you own the rollout? Need rollback criteria and whether db or config changes required.
sam: I'll own. No DB changes. Rollback criteria: 502 rate >0.7% absolute vs baseline OR p95 latency >400ms sustained 2 mins. Also abort if any node hits OOM.
deploy-bot: Release request queued for redwood/edge-proxy:hotfix-030. Canary plan: 10% -> 30% (5m) -> 100% if green. ETA 1764450000.
pm-ops: Approving expedited. Please exclude apac-edge nodes from canary due to ongoing maintenance.
sre-oncall: Oncall ack, will watch dashboards and can trigger rollback. Add an incident tag for tracking.
release-eng: Please prepare this release note blurb: "Fix header parsing crash in edge proxy causing intermittent 502s for long POST requests; no migration required."
lee: Approve. Ensure observability smoke includes synthetic long-posts.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1764450000 in pool edge-canary-1 (10%).
sam: smoke results: canary nodes steady, 502 down to 0.05% in canary, p95 120ms.
sre-oncall: Metrics link: https://metrics.redwood/edge/proxy/hotfix-030. Watching error-rate and memory.
deploy-bot: Advanced to 30% at 1764450060. Holding 5m.
pm-ops: Confirmed apac excluded, other regions fine.
lee: Nightly job that posts large payloads ran against canary — looks clean.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1764450120. No auto-rollback.
sam: Deployed to prod. No abnormal telemetry in 10m post-rollout. Will update changelog and file a brief incident summary.
release-eng: Final release note link: https://redwood.internal/releases/1764449999-edge-hotfix. I'll publish to #release-notes after your summary.
pm-ops: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
